subject: OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra 🧠, Anthropic Claude Code Mode ⛓️
notes: TensorWave/OpenAI 457 MW agreement and Tiger Data items are sponsor blocks and were ignored. No funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs or funds in this issue.

stories.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol; Astra API tokens priced 20% lower at $8 input / $40 output per million, Sol stays at $2 / $10
stories.quote: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol at one-third the cost of GPT-6
stories.description: AI lab; maker of GPT models and ChatGPT

facts.text: GPT-6.2 Astra API tokens priced 20% lower than GPT-6 Astra: $8 input / $40 output per million tokens
facts.quote: compared to GPT-6 Astra, with API tokens priced 20% lower at $8 input / $40 output per million tokens.

facts.text: Astra costs less than one third the price per task compared with GPT-6 Astra (measured per task; measurer not stated)
facts.quote: Astra costs less than 1/3 the price per task

facts.text: GPT-6.2 Sol keeps the same pricing: $2 input / $10 output per million tokens
facts.quote: , keeping the same $2 input / $10 output pricing.

facts.text: Sol approaches Astra's coding performance at roughly one fifth of the cost
facts.quote: Sol approaches Astra's coding performance at roughly

facts.text: Astra gained 22 points on cybersecurity benchmarks and is the first externally released model rated High for AI self-improvement
facts.quote: Astra jumped 22 points on cybersecurity benchmarks and is the first externally released model rated High for AI self-improvement, meaning it can meaningfully help accelerate AI research itself.

facts.text: Available in the OpenAI API and for Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex
facts.quote: in the OpenAI API. Available now for Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex.

stories.headline: Anthropic adds experimental Code Mode to Claude Code, chaining tool calls in a script and answering mid-run
stories.quote: Anthropic's experimental Claude Code mode chains tools and answers mid-run
stories.description: AI lab; maker of Claude and Claude Code

facts.text: In Code Mode Claude writes a JavaScript program that chains tool calls, runs in the session and returns a summary
facts.quote: that chains all your tool calls together. That script runs in your session, collects only the useful output, and hands Claude a clean summary. You can also get answers while long commands are still running.

facts.text: Terminal only; not available in VS Code or the Desktop app
facts.quote: Terminal only, does not work in VS Code or the Desktop app

stories.headline: OpenAI gives four outside safety teams (Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, Goodfire) embedded access to assess its models
stories.quote: OpenAI just invited four independent safety teams to dig deep inside its models and look for problems. This is called an
stories.description: AI lab; maker of GPT models and ChatGPT

facts.text: Outside experts get access to internal systems, not only the public API
facts.quote: , meaning outside experts get real access to internal systems, not just the public API.

facts.text: Apollo Research says access is still limited and does not meet its bar for a full evaluation
facts.quote: and does not yet meet its bar for a full evaluation. Still, this opens a path toward real third-party accountability in AI development.
